name: cloud-canvas
description: Cloud Canvas (#1780): Draw, a paint app on the shared Compose canvas (brush, pencil, marker, eraser, fill, shapes, line, text, eyedropper, layers, undo/redo, pinch zoom, PNG export through the Storage Access Framework), with a sibling page Board, an infinite whiteboard (Quickdraw, MIT, vendored offline in a WebView, boards saved to app storage, #1787; the fleet's tldraw build is kept pinned but not shipped: tldraw 5 does not render without a licence key), and Play, a music mixer with a sampled grand piano (Salamander Grand Piano, CC-BY 3.0), a sampled acoustic drum kit (MuldjordKit, CC-BY 4.0) and a synth (low-latency AudioTrack, polyphony, velocity layers; the synthesized piano and kit stay as the fallback), a 4 to 8 track mixer with loop recording and WAV export. Draw Enhancer sends a picture and a preset prompt to an image model through OpenRouter (key from Configs > AI or the fleet Account); Music Enhancer is a coming-soon placeholder. #1808 Painter: the Interactive Hexagon Grid, a cell painter on hex, square, triangle and octagon grids in 2D or on a 3D sphere (Three.js r128 and Inter vendored offline in a WebView, state saved to app storage). Bottom nav Draw | Painter | Board | Play | Enhancers: Board also has its own entry (the Draw > Board page stays), and Enhancers holds Draw Enhancer and Music Enhancer on one shared second row.

auto_update._doc_max_installs_per_pass: Most install sessions ONE unattended background pass may open. A background pass cannot show the system install dialog (Android 10+ blocks background activity starts), so each install it starts leaves a tap-to-install notification holding a PackageInstaller session until the user answers it. Unbounded, one pass over the 40-entry fleet opens 40 and the installer hits Android's 50-session cap - 'Too many active sessions for UID'. The remainder is picked up by the next pass. User-initiated 'Update all' is NOT capped: it runs in the foreground where the dialog appears and sessions resolve at once.
auto_update._doc_enabled: Off because this app compiles no libs:updater: the Store updates it, as it does Cloud Calc and Cloud Search.

unit._doc: This app's JVM suite in app/src/test: the stroke/undo model, layer ops, the PNG export path, the mixer mute/solo logic, the loop recorder timing model and the WAV encoder. #1787: SampleTest (the piano root, layer and pitch-ratio map, the sample voice, polyphony, velocity from the touch point, the asset set on disk) and BoardTest (the board store: create, rename, delete, atomic save, index survival, refusals). #1808: PainterTest (the Painter store: painted cells per shape and the colour, mode, scale and 2D/3D survive a restart, paint/erase/clear saved, atomic write, malformed states refused) and NavShapeTest.painterSitsRightAfterDrawAndNothingElseMoved (nav parity). The Painter page's own JS (grid generators, paint, erase, clear, strokes, persistence codec) is test/painter/grid.test.js, run with node by the shell tester test-painter.sh.

ui._doc: #868 THE nav declaration (libs:bottomnav NavDecl) of Cloud Canvas (#1780, #1782): bottom nav Draw | Play | Draw Enhancer | Music Enhancer, the app opens on Draw. Each section holds one page; the Draw tools, the Play views and the Enhancer's panels are drawn inside the page. Music Enhancer is a coming-soon placeholder whose entry is greyed out. #1787 the Draw section holds two sibling pages, Draw (the paint canvas) and Board (an infinite whiteboard: Quickdraw in a WebView, offline), shown as the shared second row. #1808 Painter (a hex/square/triangle/octagon cell painter, Three.js in a WebView, offline, 2D or 3D Sphere) is inserted right after Draw; nothing else moved: Draw | Painter | Play | Draw Enhancer | Music Enhancer. #1808 nav: Board gets its own bottom-nav entry right after Painter (the Draw > Board second-row page stays as well; the entry declares no page of its own because page ids are unique app-wide, and the shell opens the same Board page for it), and the two Enhancer sections become ONE entry, Enhancers (section id enhance, kept so the `section enhance` deep link and saved selections still resolve), whose shared second row holds Draw Enhancer (the default) and Music Enhancer (still the greyed coming-soon placeholder); the old `section music` deep link opens Enhancers > Music Enhancer. about.description: Cloud Canvas has five sections, picked in the bottom nav. Draw holds two pages: Draw, a paint app with a brush, pencil, marker, eraser, fill, line, rectangle, ellipse, text and an eyedropper, a colour picker with recent colours, layers, undo and redo, pinch zoom and pan, canvas size presets and PNG export to a folder you choose; and Board, an infinite whiteboard (Quickdraw) that works offline and keeps every board on the phone. Painter colours the cells of a hex, square, triangle or octagon grid, flat or wrapped on a sphere, and keeps each grid's painting on the phone. Play is a music mixer with a sampled grand piano, a sampled acoustic drum kit and a synth, a multitrack mixer with loop recording and WAV export. The piano and drum sounds are real recordings bundled in the app; the synth is computed on the phone.
features: Draw: brush, pencil, marker, eraser, fill, line, rectangle, ellipse, text, eyedropper
Layers with visibility, opacity and order; undo and redo; pinch zoom and pan
Canvas size presets; open a picture to paint over; export PNG to a folder you choose; share
Board: an infinite whiteboard (Quickdraw) with pen and highlighter ink, shapes, arrows, text, sticky notes, images and an eraser; several named boards saved on the phone; works with no network
Play: a sampled grand piano (3 velocity layers, a sample every 3 semitones), a sampled acoustic drum kit (10 pads) and a synth, on a low-latency audio path with polyphony and touch velocity
Mixer with 4 to 8 tracks: volume, pan, mute, solo, loop recording; tempo and metronome; WAV export

Painter: paint or rub out the cells of a hex, square, triangle or octagon grid with six colours; grid scale; 2D or 3D Sphere view with pan, zoom and orbit; Active Cells count and Clear; each grid keeps its own painting on the phone; works with no network

screens.name: Draw
screens.what: The canvas with tools, colour, size, opacity and layers.

screens.name: Board
screens.what: The infinite whiteboard with the board picker (new, rename, delete).

screens.name: Painter
screens.what: The cell grid with the shape toggle, Active Cells and Clear on top, and grid scale, Paint | Rubber | View, 2D | 3D Sphere, Center and the colours below.

screens.name: Mixer
screens.what: Tracks with volume, pan, mute, solo and loops.

guide: Pick a tool and draw; two fingers zoom and pan.
Export PNG asks for a folder once.
In Play, press Record and play: one loop pass is recorded on the selected track.
In Draw, the second row switches between Draw and Board; a board saves itself as you draw.
On the piano and the pads, a hit near the bottom edge is louder than one near the top.
In Painter, drag across the grid to paint; Rubber clears cells; View lets you pan (2D) or orbit (3D Sphere), and Center brings the grid back.
about.privacy: No ads, no trackers and no microphone: loops are recorded as notes. Board and Painter are served from the app itself and need no network; boards and the Painter grids are stored only in the app's private storage. Files are written only to the folder you pick. The only network call is the Draw Enhancer's, when you run it. A crash report is saved on the phone and sent only to the phone's own C3 WebServer over loopback.

perms._doc: #1360 every grant this app needs, by libs:perms catalogue id (needs), and the fleet apps that do work for it with the grants THEY must hold (helpers). The ONE declaration: generated into assets/app-perms.json (cloud-android-perms-guard.py --write), drawn by Configs > General > Perms (libs:perms AppPermsSection) with live state, Grant / Open and Grant all, asked at first run (first_run), and reported as 'Missing permission X - Grant' when an operation fails (PermsGate). perms-guard fails when code uses a gated API or another app's engine that is not declared here, or when the manifest and this list disagree.
